title: Chicken Tikka Masala
subtitle: Marinated grilled chicken in a rich spiced tomato cream sauce
excerpt: Chicken tikka masala is a British-Indian dish: marinated chicken pieces charred under the grill, then simmered in a spiced tomato and cream sauce. The marinade does double duty, tenderising the chicken and adding a smoky depth that carries through into the final sauce.
sourceNotes: Chicken tikka masala became popular in British Indian restaurants from the 1970s onwards. It combines the tandoor-grilled chicken tikka of north India with a British adaptation of a creamy tomato sauce.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the finished dish for up to 3 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat gently, adding a splash of water if the sauce has thickened.
recipe.batchNotes: Make a double batch of sauce and freeze half before adding cream.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken overnight in the fridge for deeper flavour.
recipe.temperatureNote: Use the grill on its highest setting to char the chicken.

content.text: The grill step is not optional. Charring the marinated chicken under a hot grill gives the dish its characteristic smoky flavour. Do not skip it and simmer raw chicken in the sauce instead.

items.prepNote: half for marinade, half for sauce

content.text: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, lemon juice, 3 crushed garlic cloves, half the ginger, 1 tsp each of cumin, coriander, and paprika, and the turmeric. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour.
When ready to cook, heat the grill to its highest setting. Spread the chicken on a lined baking tray.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until the chicken has charred patches and is cooked through.
While the chicken grills, melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion for 8 minutes until very soft.
Add the remaining garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, and garam masala. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tinned tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes. Blend until smooth if you prefer a restaurant-style sauce.
Add the grilled chicken and cream. Simmer for 5 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with rice.

items.cause: Overcooked under the grill or in the sauce.
items.fix: Grill only until just cooked; carry-over heat finishes it in the sauce.

items.cause: Tinned tomatoes were not reduced enough.
items.fix: Simmer for 5 more minutes without the lid.
